_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); railroad signals

pit_profile.why: Union Pacific: the largest railroad in North America, covering 23 states across the western two-thirds of the US, with BNSF its main rail competitor on parallel routes; carload volume follows the industrial economy, the franchise does not

classification.quality_note: Union Pacific: the largest railroad in North America, covering 23 states across the western two-thirds of the US, with BNSF its main rail competitor on parallel routes; carload volume follows the industrial economy, the franchise does not. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 0.82x; +15% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.94; conservative 2yr +9%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -7.7%/yr (worst year FY15-FY25, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +2.8%/yr (Q4 2025 revenue + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +7.8%/yr (FY15-FY25 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +24.9%/yr (best 2-yr run FY15-FY25); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: UNP (retrospective, 2026-01-28) ◎ ACCUMULATE — Ratio B 0.82x (23.1% downside to Bear $175 / +28.2% upside to Bull $292) | Adj composite 1.97 vs market 2.91: gap -0.94 [OVERVALUED] | +15% above the EPP floor $198 (17x FY26E $11.66) | Conservative 2-yr case: +9.2% total (+4.6%/yr) | At 19.5x FY26E the 15% hurdle price $301 sits above the BULL case; carloads -4% in Q4 2025, forward revenue -1% (no FY26 revenue guide, Q4 2025 freight revenue); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
